confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live listings or menus. Restaurant and coffee anchors are the more reliable; accommodation is less certain because July is peak summer season in Busan (Haeundae and beach-area demand), so prices there could run noticeably higher or lower than the typical figures given. Drink anchors are based on typical Korean bar and restaurant pricing.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of Korean urban price levels, with Busan priced somewhat below Seoul for restaurants and hotels. Drink anchors are informed by the local beer price relationship. No external price sources were used.
